Run: node scrmgr.js exe gen-shape-thresholds.mjs
THREE KINDS OF DECISION, and only one of them is a real confusion.
1. COMPOSITION -- not listed here, derived automatically.
ည against ညှ is not ambiguity. No font draws ည to look like ည+ှ, so
if the ink is nearer ညှ then the medial IS present. The ranking has
already answered it and a margin test would only throw the answer
away. The generator finds these by shape: one label is the other
plus combining marks. Measured: ဠ/ဠှ 0.0025, ည/ညှ 0.0054,
ရ/ရှ 0.0159, န/နု 0.0175 -- all tighter than most real confusions,
and none of them a confusion.
2. ATOMIC -- a single unit that cannot be a base plus a mark.
ဈ is not စ+ျ in any dictionary (only ဈေး), ၌ has no undotted base,
ဿ is not သ+ာ. So an exact match to the decomposed rival IS the
decomposed form, and an exact match to the atomic one is atomic.
The ranking decides.
3. CONFUSION -- bare consonants that genuinely look alike. These get a
HIGH bar, and when it is not met the matcher abstains and lets the
registered code page decide. Abstaining is the right answer when the
pixels cannot separate them; guessing is not.
